UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT: Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT: Continuously highlights nearby traps around you. Disabled by default for performance and visual clarity.
UI_BT_TRAPS_TITLE: This animal can be caught using these traps:
UI_BT_TRAP_DISTANCE_HINT: Traps only work if you are at least 75 tiles away.
